My main contributions to the project included forming
the group at the beginning of the project, organizing
group meetings, coordinating tasks, and helping to keep
the project on schedule. I selected and evaluated the
dataset, set up parts of the project and Quarto website
structure, and conducted the migration dynamics
analysis, including the corresponding figures and
summary tables. I also contributed to the EU/non-EU
analysis and helped structure and write the final report.
In addition, I wrote the group reflection and supported
the integration of the different analyses into a coherent
final project.
